subject: Bugfix for GIL deadlock while unloading script engine, reenable memory test in crash report (#3029)
reason: Both changes sit on paths the fuzzer cannot reach or observe. The GIL deadlock fix in scriptingEngineManagerUnregister is only invoked by VM_UnregisterScriptingEngine (unloading a module that registered a custom scripting engine while lazy-free jobs drain); this requires MODULE LOAD/UNLOAD of a custom engine module, which no installed component provides and valkey.action.commands refuses, so no experiment or compared sequence can build the condition.
